err_tab_load: This tab could not be loaded. The rest of the report is still available; try again or contact your administrator.
nat_help: Nationalisation plan: for every position held by an expatriate, one or more named national successors, a target date, the successor's readiness gap to the position and their development plan (IDP). The status is computed from the dates and the measured readiness.
nat_not_allowed: The nationalisation plan is available to managers and to administrators holding "View continuity" or "Manage succession".
nat_plans_sub: Each plan covers a position held by an expatriate. Nothing is deleted: a plan is closed (achieved or cancelled) and a successor is withdrawn, always with a reason.
nat_no_plans: No nationalisation plan within your scope.
nat_target_date_for: Plan target date for the position of {{name}}
nat_create_plan_for: Open a plan for the position of {{name}}
nat_successor_left_help: This successor is no longer with the company: they are no longer counted (not in the status, the readiness nor the regulator pack). Withdraw them with a reason and name another national.
flag_incumbent_left: The expatriate incumbent has left the company: close the plan (achieved or cancelled) or attach it to the new incumbent.
flag_incumbent_role_changed: The expatriate incumbent changed position: this plan still covers the former position.
flag_successor_left: A named successor has left the company and is no longer counted.
nat_no_successor: No national successor named — the plan is at risk.
nat_no_candidate: No national available within your scope
nat_unplanned_sub: Positions held by an expatriate within your scope that have no open nationalisation plan.
nat_all_planned: Every expatriate-held position within your scope has an open plan.
status_reason_not_ready_near_target: Target date within 6 months and no successor ready.
status_reason_successor_ready: At least one successor is ready.
pack_help: Regulatory pack per country and period: a snapshot of the workforce (nationals / expatriates by level, role family and site), the nationalisation plans and the training of nationals. A draft can be regenerated; once published it is frozen and a new version supersedes it.
pack_not_allowed: The regulatory report is available to administrators holding "View" or "Manage operational compliance".
pack_no_country: No country within your clearance: a report covers a whole country and requires a country-level clearance.
pack_generate_help: Period format: 2026-Q3 for a quarter, 2026 for a year. Generating again replaces the existing draft for the same period.
pack_ack_unspecified: I confirm publishing with {{pct}} % of nationalities not recorded
pack_exact_figures: Exact figures for the official filing
pack_publish_confirm: Publish the report {{pack}}? Once published it is frozen: only a new version can replace it.
pack_exact_note: Official filing: exact figures, by explicit decision of the person who published this report (choice recorded and logged).
pack_headcount_note: Headcount on the day the pack was generated — not an average over the period.
pack_anonymity_note: Confidentiality: any non-zero count below {{n}} is shown as "< {{n}}", and no percentage is computed on a base below {{n}}.
pack_period_open_note: The period was not closed when this pack was generated: training figures are partial.
pack_workforce_note: Active workforce on the generation date, attached to the country through their site. "Management": an employee with at least one active report. Unrecorded nationality: counted apart, never as national nor as expatriate.
print_hint: Use the browser's print function (Ctrl+P) to save this report as PDF.
nm_title: Indicators not measured by the platform
nm_wage_bill_share: Share of the wage bill paid to nationals
training_certs_valid: Holders of a valid certification at period end

err_forbidden: Action not allowed within your scope.
err_generic: The operation failed. Try again or contact your administrator.
err_no_role: This employee has no position: a plan cannot be opened.
err_nationality_unknown: Nationality not recorded (or site country unknown): record it before continuing.
err_not_expatriate: This position is held by a national: no nationalisation plan is needed.
err_plan_exists: An open plan already exists for this position.
err_successor_is_incumbent: The expatriate incumbent cannot be their own successor.
err_country_unknown: The position's country is unknown: set the site's country.
err_successor_not_national: The successor must be a national of the position's country.
err_successor_exists: This person is already a successor on this plan.
err_successor_not_active: This successor has already been withdrawn.
err_idp_forbidden: You have no authority over this person's development plan.
err_bad_period: Invalid period: 2026-Q3 for a quarter, 2026 for a year.
err_pack_not_draft: Only a draft can be published or discarded.
err_unspecified_too_high: Too many nationalities not recorded (more than 10 % of the headcount): complete them, or tick the confirmation to publish anyway.
err_successor_left: This successor has left the company: withdraw them from the plan.
